name: TRX Curl
cardText:
TRX Curl
Beginner
1
Hold the TRX straps with an underhand grip and lean back and away from the anchor point.
2
Keep your elbows high as you flex your elbows. Pull your fists toward your forehead.

name: TRX Hammer Curl
cardText:
TRX Hammer Curl
Beginner
1
Grab the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
2
Maintain a neutral grip. Flex your elbows and pull your fists to either sides of your temples.

name: TRX Reverse Curl
cardText:
TRX Reverse Curl
Intermediate
1
Stand facing the TRX straps and grasp the handles with both hands, palms facing away from your body.
2
Walk back until the straps are taut, keeping your arms straight.
3
Slowly curl your hands towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.

name: TRX Rotating Row
cardText:
TRX Rotating Row
Beginner
1
Grab the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point until the strap is taut.
2
Start with an overhand grip. Pull your elbows back and rotate your grip.
3
By the time your elbows reach your side, your palms should be facing upwards.

name: TRX Single Arm row
cardText:
TRX Single Arm row
Beginner
1
Hold the TRX strap with one hand.
2
Lean back until the strap is taut. Fully extend your elbow.
3
Pull your elbow behind the body. Make sure to avoid twisting. Try to keep your shoulders even.
